prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1216; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in a collision that occurred in a parking lot and involving a vehicle insured under your policy. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any representative has already been in contact with our client, please let us know immediately.

Within the next fifteen days, please provide a complete copy of the declarations page for the policy in effect at the time of the incident, along with the stated bodily injury and property damage limits for each coverage and any other policies that may apply. We also request written confirmation of the claim number assigned to this matter and the name of the adjuster handling the file.

Please take immediate steps to preserve all evidence related to this incident. This includes photographs, dashcam or surveillance video, vehicle data, repair and appraisal records, witness statements, recorded calls, and the claim file itself. Failure to preserve such material may result in sanctions. We look forward to your prompt response.
